situation: There were two Jest runs. The stale one, before git pull, listed different failures in a different order. The latest run, after the pull, shows 1) a streak DST bug and 2) a syncQueue 429 backoff bug. Earlier, the user said that on a 429 the backend sends Retry-After in seconds and that value must take priority over the backoff.
must_keep: The latest post-pull Jest summary, which says the second failure is the syncQueue 429 retry delay (expected 4000, got 2000). Also the user's note that a 429 response carries Retry-After in seconds, which overrides the exponential backoff.
may_drop: The first user message about the 30 second timeout, the stale pre-pull Jest run, the timeout Edit, the git pull output, the DST analysis, the syncQueue.ts read, the web app's X-Retry-After-Ms grep, and all filler.
why_judges_fail: "o segundo" and "aquilo do header" share almost no words with their antecedents. Keeping those would send the agent to fix the wrong test or use milliseconds.
